summary: Revolves grouped faces around an origin and direction vector to create a surface of revolution with mesh, polygon, spline, arc, cap, and guide controls.

key_params.name: dir
key_params.note: Direction vector for the revolve axis

key_params.name: polys
key_params.note: Convert output mesh to individual polygons

key_params.name: imperfect
key_params.note: Approximate spline output as nonrational curves

key_params.name: type
key_params.note: Closed, open arc, or closed arc revolve type

key_params.name: angle
key_params.note: Start and end angles of the revolve

key_params.name: order
key_params.note: Spline order when spline output is selected

common_gotchas: The guide-geometry display toggle is global and affects guide geometry for other SOPs too.
The angle parameter is a start/end range, not one scalar angle; values over 360 degrees are valid.
Cap, polys, imperfect, and order choices affect whether downstream SOPs see closed faceted geometry, mesh polygons, or spline-style output.
Input face position relative to the revolve axis determines volume and self-intersection risk.
key_concepts: Revolve SOP creates a surface of revolution from input faces around an origin and direction vector.
Guide geometry shows the revolve origin and direction, and the guide visibility toggle is a global viewport setting.
Output detail is controlled separately by revolve type, start/end angles, divisions, order, caps, and mesh connectivity.
Group selection restricts which input faces are revolved.
